svg.title: Power Pages ALM: how the inner and outer loops fit together
svg.desc: Overview of Power Pages application lifecycle management as two loops. The inner loop runs locally in a developer's own environment in minutes. The outer loop is shared and governed and runs over hours to days. The two meet at the pull request. Developers then sync the released baseline into their environments before starting new work.

g.text: Power Pages ALM — two loops, one source of truth
The inner loop is yours and takes minutes. The outer loop is shared and governed. They meet at the pull request.
How the two loops fit together
The inner loop repeats many times inside one developer environment; the outer loop runs once per pull request
Pull the merged result back into your Dev environment
shared · seeds the baseline into source control
one isolated environment per developer · unmanaged
managed solution import only · automatic on tag
managed solution import only · manual approval gate
